processing: Original UV retained without vertical flip
Source +X face rotated to Blender -Y / glTF +Z
Embedded 1024px sRGB JPEG basecolor
Canonical metre height, feet origin
23-bone anatomical rig fitted to static source A-pose
Four normalized weights maximum, actual exported JOINTS/WEIGHTS
Source FBX anatomical directions retargeted, per-clip source scale normalized
Horizontal root motion stripped, skinned sole grounding baked
Jump pose in place: world altitude belongs to runtime physics
Actual exported skinned sole sampled at 120 Hz; exact GLB pelvis channel corrected before final SHA
Continuous left/right priors, 150 rounds of actual topology influence smoothing, compact coat torso/cuff palette
Relaxed source ninja idle; walk/run arm counter-swing derives from original FBX leg phase
Run keeps source leg cycle and adds anatomically bent elbows instead of source arms held behind
1.20s composed jump: crouch preparation, explicit paired knee tuck and arm support, smooth landing; genuine 0.40s land_soft
limitations: Source single atlas does not expose separate skin/cloth tint or emblem sockets
No facial morphs in the source
Clothing is skinned with body; no cloth simulation
Five supplied FBX motions plus idle alias; legacy 31-action library not claimed
